40019126.author: पदार्थः
40019126.content: ते in the meantime, देवगन्धर्वदानवाः Devas, Gandharvas, Danavasरावणवधम् Ravana's destruction, दृष्टवा seeing, ते they, शुभाःauspicious, कथाः story, कथयन्तः speaking to each other, स्वैःस्वैः their, विमानैः aerial cars, जग्मुः went

40019126.author: Translation
40019126.content: In the meantime, Devas, Gandharvas, Danavas speaking to each other an auspicious story of Ravana's destruction went in their respective aerial cars.

40019127.author: पदार्थः
40019127.content: महाभागाः highly respected, रावणस्य Ravana's, घोरम् dreadful, वधम् end, राघवस्य Raghava's, पराक्रमम् prowess, वानराणाम् Vanaras, सुयुद्धम् good fight, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, मन्त्रितम् counsel, सौमित्रेः Saumithri, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, अनुरागं च love, वीर्यं च valour, सीतायाःSita's, पतिव्रतात्वम् fidelity of Sita, हनूमतिHanuman's, पराक्रमम् valiance, कथयन्तः speaking, हृष्टाःrejoiced, यथागतम् as they had come from, जग्मुः returned

40019127.author: Translation
40019127.content: Speaking about the highly respected Raghava's prowess, the end of dreadful Ravana, the good fighting of Vanaras, counsel of Sugriva, valour of Hanuman, love of Lakshmana, fidelity of Sita, all rejoiced and returned as they had come.

40019128.author: पदार्थः
40019128.content: महाभागाः highly respected, रावणस्य Ravana's, घोरम् dreadful, वधम् end, राघवस्य Raghava's, पराक्रमम् prowess, वानराणाम् Vanaras, सुयुद्धम् good fight, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, मन्त्रितम् counsel, सौमित्रेः Saumithri, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, अनुरागं च love, वीर्यं च valour, सीतायाःSita's, पतिव्रतात्वम् fidelity of Sita, हनूमतिHanuman's, पराक्रमम् valiance, कथयन्तः speaking, हृष्टाःrejoiced, यथागतम् as they had come from, जग्मुः returned

40019128.author: Translation
40019128.content: Speaking about the highly respected Raghava's prowess, the end of dreadful Ravana, the good fighting of Vanaras, counsel of Sugriva, valour of Hanuman, love of Lakshmana, fidelity of Sita, all rejoiced and returned as they had come.

40019129.author: पदार्थः
40019129.content: महाभागो honourable, राघवस्तु Raghava too, इन्द्रदत्तम् bestowed by Indra, शिखिप्रभम् aerial chariot, दिव्यम् wonderful, रथम् chariot, अनुज्ञाय bidding farewell, मातलिम् Matali, प्रत्यपूजयत् joyously returned

40019129.author: Translation
40019129.content: Bidding farewell to Matali joyously, honourable Raghava returned the aerial chariot bestowed to him by Indra.

40019130.author: पदार्थः
40019130.content: रा: he, राघवेण by Raghava, अभ्यनुज्ञातः with permission, शक्रसारथिः Indra's charioteer, मातलिःMatali, दिव्यम् wonderful, तंरथम् that chariot, आस्थाय taking, दिवमेव heaven, आरुरोह went

40019130.author: Translation
40019130.content: Matali, charioteer of Indra too taking Raghava's permission went to heaven in that wonderful chariot.

40019131.author: पदार्थः
40019131.content: तस्मिन् on his, दिवम् heaven, आरूढे ascended, सुसारथि that charioteer, सन्तमे rejoiced, राघवःRaghava, परमप्रीतः very dearly, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, परिषस्वजे embraced

40019131.author: Translation
40019131.content: "On Matali ascending to heaven, Raghava very dearly embraced Sugriva for his help in his victory."

40019132.author: पदार्थः
40019132.content: सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, परिष्वज्य च embracing, लक्ष्मणेन Lakshmana, अभिवादितः initiated by, हरिगणैः Vanara troops, पूज्यमानः worshipped, बलालयम् by the army, आजगाम went

40019132.author: Translation
40019132.content: On embracing Sugriva, greeted by Lakshmana, and worshipped by the army of Vanaras, Rama returned to the camp.

40019133.author: पदार्थः
40019133.content: अथ and then, सःकाकुत्स्थ: Kakuthsa, समीपपरिवर्तिनम् nearby surrounded, सौमित्रिम् Saumithri, सत्त्वसम्पन्नम् rich in prowess, शुभलक्षणम् of auspicious nature, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, उवाच spoke

40019133.author: Translation
40019133.content: And then, Kakuthsa spoke to Saumithri, of auspicious nature and endowed richly with prowess, who stood close by.

40019134.author: पदार्थः
40019134.content: सौम्य gentle, अनुरक्तम् very friendly, भक्तं च devotion, तथा so also, पूर्वोपकारिणम् done good work in the past, इमम् him, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, अभिषेचय consecrate

40019134.author: Translation
40019134.content: "Gentle Lakshmana! Vibheeshana is friendly to me and devoted. He has done me good work in the past. Consecrate him in Lanka."

40019135.author: पदार्थः
40019135.content: सौम्य gentle, एषः being so, मे to me, परमः very, कामः desire, यत् that, रावणानुजम् Ravana's brother, इमंविभीषणम् this Vibheeshana, लङ्कायाम् at Lanka, अभिषिक्तम् consecrate, पश्येयम् wish to see

40019135.author: Translation
40019135.content: "O gentle Lakshmana! I desire to see this Vibheeshana, Ravana's brother, consecrated at Lanka"

40019136.author: पदार्थः
40019136.content: महात्मना great self, राघवेण by Raghava, एवम् in that manner, उक्तः spoken, सौमित्रि Saumithri, तथेति same way, सुसम्हृष्टः very happy, सौवर्णम् golden, घटम् vessel, आददे arranged to get

40019136.author: Translation
40019136.content: Great selfRaghava having spoken like that, Saumithri, very happily arranged to get a golden vessel.

40019137.author: पदार्थः
40019137.content: महासत्त्व: endowed with mighty prowess, तदा then, तम् that, घटम् vessel, वानरेन्द्राणाम् chief of Vanaras, हस्ते hand, दत्त्वा given, मनोजवान् endowed with speed of mind, समुद्रसलिलम् water from the ocean, व्यादिदेश to get

40019137.author: Translation
40019137.content: Commanded like that, Lakshmana, endowed with mighty prowess placed that vessel in the hands of Vanara chief, who was endowed with the speed of the mind, to get water from the ocean.

40019138.author: पदार्थः
40019138.content: ततः then, मनोजवाः who has the speed of mind, वानरोत्तमाः foremost of Vanaras, अतिशीघ्रम् all speed, गत्त्वा going, समुद्रात् ocean's, जलम् water, गृह्य taking, आगताः came

40019138.author: Translation
40019138.content: Then the foremost of the Vanaras, endowed with the speed of mind, with all speed went and got water from the ocean.

40019139.author: पदार्थः
40019139.content: सौमित्रिः Saumithri, सुहृद्गणसमावृतः surrounded by hosts of friends and dear, ततः then, एकम् one, घटम् vessel, गृह्य taking, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, परमासने excellent seat, संस्थाप्य making to sit, तेन thereafter, घटेन with the vessel, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, मध्ये midst, मन्त्रदृष्टेन chanting sacred verses, विधिना in accordance with scriptures, रामशासनात् by Rama's command, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, राजानम् kingdom, अभ्यषिञ्चत् consecrated

40019139.author: Translation
40019139.content: Vibheeshana was made to sit on an excellent seat, surrounded by hosts of friends and dear ones. Thereafter, in the midst of Rakshasas chanting sacred verses in accordance with scriptures, Saumithri took a vessel of water and duly consecrated Vibhishana with the water in the vessel as commanded by Rama, in Lanka.

40019140.author: पदार्थः
40019140.content: सौमित्रिः Saumithri, सुहृद्गणसमावृतः surrounded by hosts of friends and dear, ततः then, एकम् one, घटम् vessel, गृह्य taking, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, परमासने excellent seat, संस्थाप्य making to sit, तेन thereafter, घटेन with the vessel, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, मध्ये midst, मन्त्रदृष्टेन chanting sacred verses, विधिना in accordance with scriptures, रामशासनात् by Rama's command, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, राजानम् kingdom, अभ्यषिञ्चत् consecrated

40019140.author: Translation
40019140.content: Vibheeshana was made to sit on an excellent seat, surrounded by hosts of friends and dear ones. Thereafter, in the midst of Rakshasas chanting sacred verses in accordance with scriptures, Saumithri took a vessel of water and duly consecrated Vibhishana with the water in the vessel as commanded by Rama, in Lanka.

40019141.author: पदार्थः
40019141.content: तदा then, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, स्तथा like that, वानराः Vanaras, अभ्यषिञ्चन् consecrated, अतुलम् extreme, प्रहर्षम् joy, गत्वा went, राममेवहि Rama alone, तुष्टुवुः paid tribute

40019141.author: Translation
40019141.content: Thereafter all the Rakshasas and Vanaras also consecrated with extreme joy and paid tribute to Rama alone.

40019142.author: पदार्थः
40019142.content: लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, अभिषिक्तम् consecrated, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa king, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, दृष्टवा seeing, तस्य his, अमात्याः ministers, अस्य his, भक्ताः devotees, येराक्षसाः this Rakshasa, जहृषिरे felt rejoiced

40019142.author: Translation
40019142.content: Seeing Vibheeshana consecrated and becoming a king of Lanka, all his ministers and devotees felt rejoiced.

40019143.author: पदार्थः
40019143.content: सहलक्ष्मणः with Lakshmana, राघवः Raghava, परमाम् extreme, प्रीतिम् felicity, जगाम felt, सः he, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, रामदत्तम् given by Rama, महत् great, तत् that राज्यम् kingdom, प्राप्य attained

40019143.author: Translation
40019143.content: Vibheeshana felt extreme felicity for attaining the kingdom given by great Rama with Lakshmana.

40019144.author: पदार्थः
40019144.content: प्रकृतीः subjects, सान्त्वयित्वा consoling with good words, ततः that, रामम् Rama, उपागमत् came, अथ and then, पौराः people, निशाचराः night ranger, सन्तुष्टाः very happy, दधि curds, अक्षतान् rice mixed with turmeric, मोदकांश्च sweets, लाजाः parched grain, तथा that way, सुमनसः flowers, तस्मै on him, आजह्रुः offered

40019144.author: Translation
40019144.content: Consoling the subjects of the kingdom with good words, Vibheeshana sought Rama's presence. The people were very happy and brought curds, yellow rice grains (rice mixed with turmeric), flowers and sweets and parched grain and offered.

40019145.author: पदार्थः
40019145.content: प्रकृतीः subjects, सान्त्वयित्वा consoling with good words, ततः that, रामम् Rama, उपागमत् came, अथ and then, पौराः people, निशाचराः night ranger, सन्तुष्टाः very happy, दधि curds, अक्षतान् rice mixed with turmeric, मोदकांश्च sweets, लाजाः parched grain, तथा that way, सुमनसः flowers, तस्मै on him, आजह्रुः offered

40019145.author: Translation
40019145.content: Consoling the subjects of the kingdom with good words, Vibheeshana sought Rama's presence. The people were very happy and brought curds, yellow rice grains (rice mixed with turmeric), flowers and sweets and parched grain and offered.

40019146.author: पदार्थः
40019146.content: दुर्धर्षः difficult to encounter, वीर्यवान् valiant, सःhe, तान् him, गृहीत्वा received, सर्वम् all, माङ्गल्यम् benign offerings, मङ्गलम् auspicious, राघवाय to Raghava, लक्ष्मणाय and Lakshmana, न्यवेदयत् presented

40019146.author: Translation
40019146.content: Valiant Vibheeshana, who is difficult to encounter, presented the benign offerings and auspicious ones received by him to Rama and Lakshmana.

40019147.author: पदार्थः
40019147.content: रामः Rama, कृतकार्यम् accomplished, समृद्धार्थम् richly endowed, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, दृष्टवा seeing, तस्य his, प्रियकाम्ययाएव to please, तत् those, सर्वम् all, प्रतिजग्राह received in return

40019147.author: Translation
40019147.content: Rama having accomplished the task, thoughtfully pleased did not desire for the offerings, accepted them to please Vibheeshana.

40019148.author: पदार्थः
40019148.content: ततः then, रामःRama, शैलोपमम् like mountain, वीरम् hero, प्राञ्जलिम् greeting with joined palms, प्रणतम् supplicant mood, स्थितम् stood, प्लवङ्गमम् Vanara, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, इदंवचः these words, उवाच spoke

40019148.author: Translation
40019148.content: Then Rama, seeing a heroic mountain like Hanuman, who stood there in supplicant mood greeting him with joined palms, spoke these words.

40019149.author: पदार्थः
40019149.content: सौम्य gentle, महाराजम् great king, इमम् this, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, अनुज्ञाप्य with permission, लङ्कांनगरीम् Lanka city, प्रविश्य entering, मैथिलीम् Mythili, कौशलम् wellbeing, ब्रूहि enquire

40019149.author: Translation
40019149.content: "O Gentle Hanuman! Taking the permission of the great king Vibheeshana, entering the city of Lanka, enquire the wellbeing of Mythili."

40019150.author: पदार्थः
40019150.content: वदताम् eloquent, श्रेष्ठ best, माम् me, सलक्ष्मणम् and Lakshmana, सुग्रीवं च and Sugriva, कुशलिनम् are doing well, रावणम् Ravana, रणे in combat, हतम् killed, वैदेह्यै Vaidehi, आचक्ष्व tell her

40019150.author: Translation
40019150.content: "Convey to Vaidehi that me and Lakshman and also Sugriva are doing well, and that Ravana has been killed, O Best among the eloquent."
